book.name: 2 Korinti
book.title: PAS NAMBA TU PAULO MENI KORINTI EMARE GAENUA

content: Ge ninai dubu eni meni otao mamai soga wewa.
Otao mamai, Tuara dubu Masedonia provinsra ena nowera numorekare Anutu meni dumi pumaira putou potisia amira ge sanakare niniu.

Tuara dubu eni meni Tuara dubu Yudaya zebura bogamasa nowera nukare awa soga wamu moni dara potitinowera. Are Tuara dubu Masedonia zebura itewera ami yaya-buyaya bamubake amira tame noise bogamasa nowera, ata saineba gera yawa sara bamubake nusokare nana itia, are nukare otao mamai enire dumi pupinoise moni meni soremamu sero sia wero potera be kasaba dero zozisia. Na numorekare ego giro baititinona: nukare nutopekare kotumai nusokare peu wero potaira putou nusokare amira te wero nena potitinomite potaira putou nusokare awa dainitinoise bamubake potisera awa. Nukare dubu awa soremamu sero awita sero nakare ninanisekare begomo sisera.
“Nukare omata pei-kaka kenara potamunora” asisenakare. Ata tepo awa. Nukare bere gita duba nusokare Tuare potiro amire Anutura ara tamai ama ganinoise duba nusokare namorekare dai potisera awa.
Nukare ago wisera, are Tito meni nisokare nana omata dara potaira bua zaawero inomite agewa dotisia, awa pesunaise tonakare awa.

Are tuma diaire, ge tugata waire, gera susu giro baitaire, buara putoure, dubara dumi namorekare paire — nena ago ine amira putou nisokare nana zapinowia, are otao sogawaira putou ami dai nisokare nana zamaise.
Na potai ge nimorekare oko potitinona. Ata Tuara dubu eni meni bua awa wamu yaba inora, are nisokare nana dubara dumi bamubake iti sia amira susu kei awaise tona awa.
Nikare Tua nasokai Yesu Kristo amira dumi yagaba nusore ninitinowewa. Nu zamai bamubakere meni nikare emo bogamasa wenua. Awa bogamasa nusora nikare zamaire wawise ago ine wenua awa.
Are na ge ei awa tepo nikare tugata inona, ata niniwo me wae. Nikare dubu eni gita inoise zepa matura ena omata poti dara namu sero peu wero bua zaawisewa,
awa susumuro wero pesuniwo. Ago wawa bua wero pesunaira peu wai nisokare meni bua zaawaira peu wai nisokare amira te wamunoya. Moni potaira putou nisokare nana itia, amira te potiwo.
Zo nu nena potamu peu inoya ami nena potaira putou nuso nana itia amira te nena potai Anutu meni gai te wamunoya. Nena nuso nana oko itia amira te potaise sai oko itia.
Eni meni tama bisi asaire nuara nikare yaya nina-ninare tamawise oko tona.
Zeme emire zamai nisokare nana itia ami dora botiyo nusokare tunai nena te kei awaise tona awa. Are noma be zo zamai nusokare meni dora botiyo nisokare tunai nisokare nana te da ago kei awaise tona.
Ge gayai zo ego itia ewa, Nena dainiro sianinua ami zamaire oko wenua. Noko nena etokaka sianinua ami dora botiyore oko wenua.
Paulo meni Tito ata otao nuso eto Korinti nate iyetamu sero
ge nusokare gaenua.
Anutu nu Tito duba gaenu na nikare emo yaba bamubake inowena da ago ine nune inoya awa. Are na Anuture kokopai asinona.
Nu nisokare nana bayaise sesena ninisia. A gege kota, nisokare nana mamu peu wero baitiro kotumai nusora nisokare nana tupia awa.
Gera otao nasokare zo Tuara Oziga Ewanana tugata wawi Tuara dubu dapikarago giro nu yaba inowera, nu dai iyetena susawerato awa.

Tuara dubu dapikarago nukare ema awa namore dai noise moni poti dara naira buara na soremaise sesera kei awisia. Are na moni poti dara naira bua inowena, awa eni meni Tua bowi warise, o ema bogamasa sogawamu peu inowena amira susu awa kerenamu sero inowena.
Zo meni opi toise na moni emi emo gera potai azu, moni bamu awa dia ina-wa inoise puro poti dara nitinowenakare awa.
Nakare nena wanakare Tua meni gege gai ewanana waise kota, ema meni dai gara ewanana waise towenakare.
Na nuto ata otao nasokare zo dai iyetena susawera awa. Ema awa be eni buara gaero gamu wero gawenakare zewai wai nusora susu kei awinowia awa. Numa nikare emo yawa sara inoise buara zewai inoya awa.

Nikare Tito giro ego sewo, “Nu Paulora otao sogawai. Nuto bua mai nasokai nowerato.” Ota otao nasokai eto awa giro ego sewo, “Nuto Tuara dubu meni iyetitinora awa. Nuto Kristora zazo de ike nitinowerato.”
Na zazo nisokare de ike nitinowena amira ge awa me waise ema ago ine meni nisokare nana mara otao-gamao wewo Tuara dubu eni meni ninare.
